patient_summary: Synthetic abnormal uterine bleeding case with perimenopausal bleeding and endometrial thickening.

stages.visible_information: Initial outpatient complaint: irregular heavy bleeding.
stages.doctor_action: Request pregnancy test, transvaginal ultrasound, CBC, and endometrial sampling consideration.
stages.environment_feedback: Ultrasound reports endometrial thickening; pregnancy test is negative.

stages.visible_information: Admission history and ultrasound remain concerning for endometrial lesion.
stages.environment_feedback: Procedure is completed and specimen is sent.

stages.doctor_action: Confirm final diagnosis and avoid overtreatment.
Recommend routine follow-up and return precautions.
